title: How do I renew my certification?

nodes.label: Log CE credits
nodes.detail: Record each course or session as you finish it so the audit finds your 30 required credits.

nodes.label: Submit renewal
nodes.detail: Send the renewal form and pay the fee before your certificate expires on December 31.

nodes.label: Enough CE credits?
nodes.detail: Staff verify your logged credits against the renewal requirement.

nodes.label: Issue new certificate
nodes.detail: Your new certificate is issued and the next 3-year renewal cycle begins.

nodes.label: Short on credits
nodes.detail: If you are short on credits, staff offer a 90-day extension instead of letting the certificate lapse.

nodes.label: Make up credits
nodes.detail: Earn and log the missing credits during the 90-day grace window, then resubmit.

nodes.label: Payment fails
nodes.detail: A declined payment puts the renewal on hold until the fee is paid.

cards.title: Renew before December 31
cards.body: Log 30 CE credits and submit the form and fee before your certificate expires.

cards.title: Short on CE credits?
cards.body: Ask for a 90-day extension instead of letting your certification lapse.
